root_cause_analysis.summary: The PoC is parsed as an in-memory blosc2 frame. For contiguous frames, frame_get_lazychunk returns *chunk as an interior pointer into frame->cframe and should leave *needs_free false. If an error occurs after that, the cleanup path checks `if (needs_free)`, i.e. the address of the out-parameter supplied by frame_decompress_chunk, instead of the boolean value. Because the out-parameter address is non-null, the cleanup frees the interior frame pointer and ASan reports bad-free.
root_cause_analysis.why_patch_works: The patch changes the cleanup condition to `if (*needs_free)`, so only chunks actually allocated by frame_get_lazychunk are freed. Interior pointers into a contiguous frame are no longer passed to free on error paths.
